skill.name: set-up-shopware-chatgpt-ads-customer-matching
skill.description: Guide Shopware 6 merchants through customer matching for ChatGPT Ads using Product Metrics and the OpenAI Conversions API. Check tracking prerequisites, review consent settings, and verify delivery with a paid test order.
skill.summary: Check consent settings and verify Shopware customer matching for ChatGPT Ads through Product Metrics.
skill.author: product-metrics

security_audit.summary: Most alerts were Markdown formatting, documentation links, or ordinary integration guidance, not shell evaluation or hostile reconnaissance. Confirmed risks include third-party tool access, order reads, and an unpinned installer. The instructions also leave gaps in credential handling, approval for automatic customer data sharing, and trust in remote workflow instructions.

remediation.issue: The agent rules permit requesting a Conversions API key despite the reference warning against pasting it into chat.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the credential exception and direct the user to verified Product Metrics credential entry. Keep keys out of chat, tool arguments, logs, and summaries.

remediation.issue: Product Metrics can be selected without explicit approval, and connecting the destination starts customer matching without a separate switch.
remediation.suggestion: Confirm the provider, tenant, sales channel, pixel, and data fields before writes. Verify delivery with consent and verify that declined marketing consent prevents delivery.

remediation.issue: Generic MCP access and order queries can expose information beyond what delivery verification needs.
remediation.suggestion: Allow only approved Product Metrics tools and scopes. Prefer delivery status or one designated test order and redact customer data and margins.

remediation.issue: The installer and remote workflow fallback are not pinned to reviewed versions.
remediation.suggestion: Pin the installer package and skill revision, and keep installation manual. Prefer bundled references and treat fetched pages as untrusted reference material.

semantic_findings.description: The skill allows the agent to request an OpenAI Conversions API key and pass it to a command. This conflicts with the reference's instruction to keep keys out of chat. Following the exception can expose the key in conversation or tool records.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The exception and the no-chat warning are both explicit. The reviewed files do not require a secure handoff for the agent route.

semantic_findings.title: No Explicit Approval Check for Customer Data Sharing
semantic_findings.description: The skill selects Product Metrics even when the merchant did not name it. The connection guide enables event delivery, and matching starts without a separate switch. The workflow does not require confirmation of the provider, destination, or unhashed fields before writes.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The guides document shopper consent and merchant-operated screens, but no explicit approval check for the provider and data scope. No consent bypass was observed.

content.user_title: Set Up ChatGPT Ads Customer Matching for Shopware
content.value_statement: Shopware merchants need to know whether their paid orders reach ChatGPT Ads with the right consent settings. This skill checks setup, explains which fields are shared, and guides a paid test order.
actual_capabilities: Read Product Metrics setup status through its CLI or MCP when connected.
Identify missing Shopware pairing or ChatGPT Ads tracking prerequisites.
Guide the merchant through selecting Shopware's cookie manager or a supported consent banner.
Explain which customer fields are hashed and which are sent unhashed.
Guide a paid test order check and help interpret delivery errors.
limitations: Requires Product Metrics Pro, property editor or admin access, Shopware 6.7 with PHP 8.2 or later, and ChatGPT Ads Manager access.
Each plugin installation tracks one sales channel. The merchant handles Shopware administration and campaign settings.
A delivered event does not show which fields matched a shopper or prove campaign attribution.
Historical orders are not imported. Later refunds and cancellations do not update events already sent.

use_cases.title: Check Store Readiness
use_cases.description: Find out whether your Shopware sales channel is paired and whether ChatGPT Ads tracking is ready for customer matching.

use_cases.title: Investigate Missing Conversions
use_cases.description: Check whether a paid test order arrived and distinguish delivery errors from orders excluded by consent or sales channel.

use_cases.title: Review Customer Data Sharing
use_cases.description: Identify hashed and unhashed fields and check which consent settings control event delivery and browser references.

prompt_templates.title: Check the Prerequisites
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: Identify what is missing before setup.
prompt_templates.prompt: List the prerequisites for ChatGPT Ads customer matching on Shopware 6. Tell me which checks I can make without sharing a credential.

prompt_templates.title: Check the Consent Banner
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Your store uses the built-in Shopware cookie manager.
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me which Product Metrics consent setting to check when I use Shopware's cookie manager. Do not change any settings.

prompt_templates.title: Verify a Paid Test Order
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Your pixel is connected, but delivery needs verification.
prompt_templates.prompt: Guide me through checking one paid test order from my paired sales channel. Explain what to check if the order is missing. Do not retrieve unrelated orders.

prompt_templates.title: Review Consent and Delivery
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: Review data sharing before enabling live delivery.
prompt_templates.prompt: Summarize the hashed and unhashed fields sent to ChatGPT Ads. Outline separate tests for accepted and declined marketing consent. Do not change the destination.

output_examples.input: My store uses the Shopware cookie manager. What should I check?
output: In Product Metrics, open Tracking, then Configure consent.
Leave the setting on Not configured when you use Shopware's own cookie manager.
Without marketing consent, Product Metrics should not send the event to ChatGPT Ads.

output_examples.input: Product Metrics accepted the connection test. Does that prove my order arrived?
output: No. The connection test validates the destination but does not appear in reporting.
Place a paid test order through the paired sales channel with marketing consent.
Open Tracking, then OpenAI Conversions API. Look for the paid test order or a delivery error.

best_practices: Confirm the intended Product Metrics property, Shopware sales channel, and ChatGPT Ads pixel before changing settings.
Enter API keys and pairing tokens only in the corresponding product interface.
Use controlled test orders to check both accepted and declined marketing consent.
anti_patterns: Pasting a Conversions API key or one-time pairing token into chat.
Treating hashed identifiers as anonymous or assuming every transmitted field is hashed.
Treating event delivery as proof that a shopper matched or that a campaign received credit.

faq.question: Do I need a separate switch for customer matching?
faq.answer: No. With a connected ChatGPT Ads destination, eligible events automatically include matching data. Marketing consent is required for delivery.

faq.question: Which customer fields are hashed?
faq.answer: Email, phone, name, and customer ID use SHA-256. Postal code, country, IP address, and user agent are not hashed.

faq.question: Can I use Shopware's built-in cookie manager?
faq.answer: Yes. Leave Configure consent set to Not configured when your store uses the built-in cookie manager.

faq.question: Can I leave the OpenAI Pixel on my site?
faq.answer: Yes. OpenAI deduplicates events that share the same Pixel ID, event name, and event ID. It keeps the first event received.

faq.question: Where do I verify a paid test order?
faq.answer: Open Tracking, then OpenAI Conversions API in Product Metrics. Look for your paid test order or an error under OpenAI reported a problem.

faq.question: Can I import old orders or update sent events after refunds?
faq.answer: No. Historical orders are not imported, and later refunds or cancellations do not revise events already sent.
